FIELDS.NAME: The Rustic Table
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
The Rustic Table is a family-friendly restaurant focusing on providing a diverse menu of high-quality, freshly prepared meals in a warm and inviting atmosphere. Our operations include both dine-in and takeout services; however, we maintain a strict policy that limits alcohol sales to beer and wine only, ensuring that no liquor or spirits are served. The establishment covers a total area of 6,500 square feet and has a maximum seating capacity of 120 customers, which allows us to manage crowd dynamics effectively while maintaining a focus on food service. We adhere to all health and safety regulations, ensuring all cooking appliances are equipped with proper fire suppression and ventilation systems to mitigate any fire hazards. Our commitment to food quality extends to sourcing ingredients from reputable suppliers, ensuring fresh and safe meals for our patrons. We are open year-round and operate without seasonal closures, providing consistent service to our community.

Our restaurant offers a diverse selection of beverages, including a full range of spirits, cocktails, and liquors to complement our dining experience.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: "Not applicable; the restaurant has not experienced any losses."
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Wall-mounted safe, Class B, Dual key lock system.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Additional security measures include the installation of a security camera system and regular security patrols to maintain a safe environment for customers and staff, adhering to the operational guidelines and enhancing overall protection.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – The Rustic Table does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The focus is on providing a safe dining environment with adherence to health and safety regulations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – The Rustic Table does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its operational focus, which primarily centers on providing dining services.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance, as this is necessary for risk transfer and liability protection. The certificates are typically checked by the management or a designated insurance coordinator within the organization.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The Rustic Table maintains a clean record with no indictments or convictions related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crimes. We prioritize compliance and adhere to all operational guidelines to ensure a safe and responsible dining environment.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – The Rustic Table has not experienced any policy or coverage declines, cancellations, or non-renewals in the past three years. We maintain a good operational and risk management practices.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – The Rustic Table does not lease employees to or from other employers. Our staffing is managed internally to maintain consistency and control over our operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – The Rustic Table does not currently have any Workers Compensation insurance coverage in place. This is a requirement for compliance and needs to be addressed before proceeding.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – The Rustic Table does not own or operate any other business; it solely focuses on its restaurant operations.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – The Rustic Table does not have any other insurance with this company. We maintain only the specified policy for our restaurant operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – The Rustic Table does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products as part of its restaurant operations, focusing instead on providing high-quality meals and a family-friendly dining experience.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – The Rustic Table does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our operations focus solely on serving our customers within the restaurant.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The Rustic Table has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years. The establishment maintains a stable financial position without any significant financial distress.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – The Rustic Table does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus on providing a safe dining environment without engaging in hazardous material handling.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – The Rustic Table limits alcohol sales to beer and wine only, with no liquor or spirits permitted, adhering to the outlined regulations. This operational policy aligns with our commitment to a family-friendly dining environment and mitigates liquor liability exposure.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – The Rustic Table has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The restaurant maintains a strong commitment to a safe and respectful environment for both staff and patrons.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – The Rustic Table maintains proper fire safety regulations and all cooking appliances are equipped with fire suppression and ventilation systems. There are no uncorrected fire code violations.
